product_one_liner.value: Bizagi is a low-code process-automation and orchestration platform for enterprises that connects people, systems, data, AI and bots to automate business processes.
product_one_liner.notes: The company About page describes a low-code platform for automating and orchestrating business processes and connecting people, systems, data, AI and bots; the homepage identifies its focus as enterprise apps.

pricing_page.notes: Bizagi has a public pricing page describing consumption-based pricing and linking to a pricing brochure and quote request.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Bizagi’s customer pages identify DHL Group and Unilever International as customers. | named_customers.0: Bizagi’s customer page names DHL Group. | named_customers.1: Bizagi’s customer page names Unilever International.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists Bizagi’s company size as 201–500 employees, which matches the required band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Bizagi identifies Washington DC as its headquarters and its offices page labels the Washington DC location as the corporate headquarters. | hq_country: Bizagi’s LinkedIn company profile identifies Washington DC as headquarters, and its address listing identifies the U.S.; together these support United States as the headquarters country.

founded_year.notes: Bizagi’s About page says it was founded in Bogotá in 1989.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index lists editorial posts about enterprise automation, AI agents, BPO automation, and business processes, rather than multiple engineering-written articles explaining how the product is built; this supports a negative under the stated threshold.

public_docs.notes: Bizagi provides public API documentation and a help portal containing product documentation, including multiple AI-approach articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Bizagi’s live career site lists an AI-First Full Stack Developer role, which is an open role with AI in its title.

model_provider.notes: Bizagi’s AI approach documentation states that the platform embeds Azure Private OpenAI GPT, and says its AI capabilities use models provided through Microsoft Azure services.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The compliance page expressly says Bizagi is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and its GDPR page names GDPR compliance; these are the requested listed items. | compliance_certs.0: The compliance page states that Bizagi is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified. | compliance_certs.1: Bizagi’s compliance page names GDPR and describes its GDPR compliance commitment.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company’s funding profile identifies its latest round as private equity (PE). | funding_date: The funding profile dates Bizagi’s latest private-equity round to September 13, 2017; expressed as YYYY-MM, this is 2017-09. | funding_amount_usd: Tracxn reports total funding of $48 million in one round, and Bizagi’s funding announcement headline identifies a $48 million investment; this is the reported amount for the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round shown is dated September 2017, well before the 18-month window preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Bizagi’s career site has a live Business Development Representative (BDR) posting, meeting the stated hiring criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: Bizagi announced its Summer 2026 platform release on July 21, 2026, including significant new AI insight and automation features, which falls within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Samir Gulati’s profile shows a Bizagi employment end date in April 2026 and identifies his title as Chief Marketing Officer, indicating a C-level departure within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Bizagi BDR job listing says the role uses tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Outreach to maintain activity and pipeline data. | crm_stack_signal.0: The BDR job listing names LinkedIn Sales Navigator as a work tool. | crm_stack_signal.1: The BDR job listing names Outreach as a work tool.
